title: location
description: A place on Earth, of any size: a doorway, a street address, a 20-acre property with one street address and several GPS points, a parcel, a route. It has names, addresses, GPS shapes, a time zone and facts about the place itself, and nothing else. It holds NO knowledge of who lives, owns, operates or delivers there: those are location_link records, which can start and end while the location never changes. What stands on the place (a house with three bedrooms) is a separate thing, not stored here. Family or any other relationship between people is never inferred from sharing a location. Endpoint rules the schema cannot express: at least one of name, addresses or geometries; at most one primary address; a civic address needs a country; valid_from not after valid_to; GeoJSON coordinates in range and nested right for their type; time_zone is a real IANA name; part_of_location_id exists, is not itself and makes no loop; a location with a live location_link cannot be retired or deleted (conflict, id:in_use); an address already used by another live location is a warning to the operator (the server reports the match; it never merges).
x_retention: Kept as long as any link points at it. A residential location is retired and its personal details removed when its last residence link is erased with the person; a location a venue or organization still links to stays. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

kind.description: How big a thing this is: point (a doorway or a spot), site (a building, campus or property), parcel (a legal lot) or route (a street or trail). Optional; site when absent. Neighborhoods and cities are not locations here.

name.description: What people call the place, such as 'Boulder Public Library' or 'Beetcher home'. Optional, but a location needs at least one of name, addresses or geometries.

aliases.description: Other names the place is or was known by. Up to 20.

description.description: What the place physically is, in words: 'two-story brick building on the corner, parking behind'. About the place only; never who lives, owns or operates there. Optional.

addresses.description: Every street, mailing and former address of this place, each with a usage. Up to 20. One may be primary.

usage.description: What this address is for: civic (where the place physically is, for deliveries and emergency services), mailing (where mail goes), po_box, or former (no longer valid but remembered). Required.

description.description: A few words about this address: 'main gate on Elm St', 'rear entrance'. Optional.

lines.description: The address as printed, one string per line, top to bottom. Use these for anything that does not fit the parts below, or for a foreign address. Up to 6 lines.

street_number.description: House or building number, such as 1000 or 12B. Optional.

street.description: Street name with direction and type, such as Walnut St or 'W County Road 7'. Optional.

unit.description: Suite, apartment or floor, such as 'Suite 4'. Optional.

region.description: State, province or county-level region. Two capital letters for the US (CO). Optional.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code, as written. Optional.

country.description: Two capital letters, ISO 3166 (for example US). Required on a civic address.

valid_from.description: First day the address applies, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

valid_to.description: Last day the address applies, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; absent means still valid.

is_primary.description: True on the one address to show first. At most one address in the list may be primary. Optional.

verification.description: How much the address has been checked: none, self_reported (someone said so) or verified (checked against mail, a map or an official record). Optional; none when absent.

geometries.description: Every GPS point, line or outline for this place, each with a role. A 20-acre property can hold a center point, four gate points and a boundary. Up to 50.

role.description: What the shape marks: center (a representative point), entrance, boundary (the outline of the place), parcel (the legal lot) or other. Required.

geometry.description: The shape as GeoJSON (RFC 7946): longitude first, then latitude, WGS84, optional altitude in meters. Required.

type.description: Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon or MultiPolygon.

coordinates.description: GeoJSON coordinates for the type. Longitude -180 to 180, latitude -90 to 90; the handler checks the ranges and the nesting for the type.

accuracy_m.description: How close the shape is to the truth, in meters. Optional.

source.description: Where the shape came from: gps_device, map_click, geocoder, survey, public_record or other. Optional.

as_of.description: When the shape was captured, as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

label.description: A short label, such as 'north gate'. Optional.

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone name such as America/Denver. Optional.

type.description: What kind of identifier, lowercase words and underscores, such as parcel_number. Required.

description.description: A few words about it. Optional.

identifiers.description: Outside identifiers for the place: county parcel number, utility id, a venue code. Each has a type, a value and an optional description. Up to 20. Not personal data about a person.

type.description: What kind of characteristic, lowercase words and underscores, such as parcel_number. Required.

value.description: The characteristic, in a few words, such as fenced or gravel_lot. Required.

description.description: A few words about it. Optional.

characteristics.description: Facts about the place itself, never about who is there: fenced, gravel lot, steep driveway. Each has a type, a value and an optional description. Up to 20.

part_of_location_id.description: The larger location this one sits inside (a doorway inside a campus). One parent at most; not itself and not a loop. Optional.

status.description: active (default when omitted) or retired (kept for history; not offered in pickers). A location with a live link cannot be retired.

is_residential.description: True while any active resides_at link points at this location; false otherwise. Used to find homes whose residents need privacy. Set by the server (the link service).

address_keys.description: Normalized strings made from the addresses (number, street, unit, locality, region, postal code), used to find a place that already exists. Set by the server; not personal data on its own.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
